import requests
import json
import os

# Pixiv公共API - 排行榜
RANKING_URL = "https://www.pixiv.net/ranking.php"

# 请求参数 - 男性向排行榜
params = {
    "mode": "male",      # 男性向排行榜
    "content": "illust", # 插画
    "date": "",          # 留空表示今日
    "format": "json",    # JSON格式返回
    "p": 1,              # 页码
}

# 请求头
headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36",
    "Referer": "https://www.pixiv.net/",
}

# 发送请求
response = requests.get(RANKING_URL, params=params, headers=headers)
print(f"状态码: {response.status_code}")
print(f"URL: {response.url}")

if response.status_code == 200:
    data = response.json()
    print(f"\n成功获取数据!")
    print(f"条目数量: {len(data.get('contents', []))}")
    
    # 显示前10个作品信息
    contents = data.get('contents', [])
    for i, item in enumerate(contents[:10]):
        print(f"\n[{i+1}] 排名: {item.get('rank')}")
        print(f"    作品ID: {item.get('illust_id')}")
        print(f"    标题: {item.get('title')}")
        print(f"    作者: {item.get('user_name')}")
        print(f"    缩略图: {item.get('url')}")
else:
    print(f"请求失败: {response.text}")
